## Meeting Purpose

[Demo the app prototype for Grupo Casais' canteen management system and discuss next steps](https://fathom.video/share/p5bWE2P-jSUMPoa8N3SSZTUCJQtAy3Ms?tab=summary&timestamp=3.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [Prototype demonstrates core functionality for workers, chefs, and admins including meal selection, check-ins, menu creation, and reporting](https://fathom.video/share/p5bWE2P-jSUMPoa8N3SSZTUCJQtAy3Ms?tab=summary&timestamp=81.0)
  - [Key areas for refinement: menu creation workflow, multi-canteen support, reporting/analytics, and UI/UX improvements](https://fathom.video/share/p5bWE2P-jSUMPoa8N3SSZTUCJQtAy3Ms?tab=summary&timestamp=108.0)
  - [Development proposal: free initial build with revenue share model based on food waste savings (e.g. 25-30%)](https://fathom.video/share/p5bWE2P-jSUMPoa8N3SSZTUCJQtAy3Ms?tab=summary&timestamp=1710.0)
  - [Timeline: Aiming for trial launch on July 21st, with full launch event on July 28th](https://fathom.video/share/p5bWE2P-jSUMPoa8N3SSZTUCJQtAy3Ms?tab=summary&timestamp=2332.0)

## Topics

### Worker Interface

  - [Dashboard shows today's meals and check-in option](https://fathom.video/share/p5bWE2P-jSUMPoa8N3SSZTUCJQtAy3Ms?tab=summary&timestamp=180.0)
  - [Weekly meal selection interface needs refinement (e.g. icons for dietary restrictions)](https://fathom.video/share/p5bWE2P-jSUMPoa8N3SSZTUCJQtAy3Ms?tab=summary&timestamp=388.0)
  - [Future enhancements: worker profiles, dietary preferences, GPS-based canteen assignment](https://fathom.video/share/p5bWE2P-jSUMPoa8N3SSZTUCJQtAy3Ms?tab=summary&timestamp=434.0)

### Chef Interface

  - [Menu creation workflow: debate between daily vs weekly menu planning](https://fathom.video/share/p5bWE2P-jSUMPoa8N3SSZTUCJQtAy3Ms?tab=summary&timestamp=593.0)
  - [Meal queue management system for real-time lunch service](https://fathom.video/share/p5bWE2P-jSUMPoa8N3SSZTUCJQtAy3Ms?tab=summary&timestamp=245.0)
  - [Ideas for future: ingredient-based grocery lists, auto-menu generation](https://fathom.video/share/p5bWE2P-jSUMPoa8N3SSZTUCJQtAy3Ms?tab=summary&timestamp=507.0)
